_comment: Pinned for AMD RDNA3 (RX 7900 XTX / gfx1100): autotune config (num_warps=2, num_stages=4) hung 3+ hours during AMDGCN codegen. (num_warps=2, num_stages=2) was the fastest observed candidate at 21.7s. See fla/ops/gated_delta_rule/wy_fast.py's existing Blackwell instability guard for this same kernel (upstream issue #913) -- no equivalent guard exists yet for AMD.
